context:
昨日兩人的配信很多交叉內容所以直接合併整理：

-出場順序，像是Solo Part🌽🌸☄️的順序其實都是營運決定的。🌸聽到後非常開心的傳訊息給☄️。
-因為☄️最近太忙所以一直到前兩天才決定主持環節要寫信。還緊急請姐街把信紙印出來然後當天下午才偷偷帶到休息室寫完。
-由於現場配信時都穿著動補衣所以身上沒有口袋可以放信，最後放在了腰帶裡，結果信拿給AZKi時都皺皺的，還帶著自己的體溫。
-☄️回到後台時🌸哭著過來抱☄️還邊打著☄️說笨蛋、笨蛋。
-一開始🌽還沒有哭，但後來聽到AZKi說沒有畢業真是太好了直接破防。
-Fes結束後🌸☄️兩人是一起回家的。
-🌽🌸都被請去住酒店了，麻內們知道大家的房號以防有人睡過頭時可以直接去叫人。
-🌸晚上睡不著有傳Line給🌽問她要不要過來自己房間，結果🌽先睡了沒回應（還是說她不敢回應呢⋯）
-隔天早上🌸手機沒充到電但幸好有在該起來的時候醒過來，🌽也有傳Line 叫她。
-最近🌽🌸☄️這三人幾乎天天在一起。
-🌸改開台時間是因為要開會，而且是全部零期生的會議。
-☄️的Newton MV製作中。
-☄️想要有自己的Expo。
-成員們在後台看直播時都在找女粉，只要有自己的女粉出現大家就都會很興奮。
-☄️知道自己是壓軸後覺得壓力很大。
-成員們在後台待機時有玩撲克牌，🌸玩的時候還作弊。
-🌸很尊敬🌽對Hololive的愛。
-🌸發現☄️改了Last Frontier歌詞時又爆哭。
-在EXPO開始前成員們有先逛一次會場的機會，由工作人員帶領她們並且有分組，🌸☄️🔥🐑一組，🔥🐑很乖但🌸☄️就很興奮到處亂跑還帶著自己的娃娃到處拍照。
-試吃環節🌸選了商業套餐，☄️選了SMOK的餐點，🌸很生氣的問☄️為什麼不選商業套餐，☄️回答因為妳會分我，這樣我們就會一起吃那一份了。
-原本營運設計的商業餐是甜點，後來🌸☄️怕太甜不妥所以改漢堡了。
-🍃毫不意外的選了商業套餐，拿到mc卡後🌸☄️幫她簽了名。🍃不只是星詠她現在也是堅定的mcmt推。
-🌸☄️看到那個mcmt左右半心的也問營運說這真的沒問題嗎，不過這個最終被保留。
-表演當天的員工餐是Buffet，☄️真的就狂夾肉一點蔬菜都沒拿。
-3月24日火建有連動還會有公布。
-🌸也很想辦自己的Solo Live，最近也很努力的在連續發歌。
-🌸表示今天沒辦法來的及唸完所有的SC很抱歉，明天開始會恢復正常配信，還有希望大家在鯛魚燒活動結束前多去吃一些。

There are lots of contents that’s interchangeable between the two from their streams yesterday, so I am going to combine them here :

-The order, such as the sequence they get on to the stage for🌸☄️🌽solo part were all decided by the managements. 🌸was very excited after she found out about the sequence and sent Line message to☄️right after.
-☄️was so busy lately so it was not until just two days before the performing day that she’s decided to write a letter to⚒️. ☄️had to asked Anemachi to print out the letter paper and bring it to the staff room to eventually finish writing the letter.
-On the performing day, since they all had to wear motion capture suit, there was no pocket on the suit, so☄️had to hid the letter on the wrist belt. When☄️pulled out the letter to give to⚒️, it was all wrinkled, and the letter has her body warmth.
-After the performance☄️went back to the standby room and🌸was yelling baka, baka and were punching☄️lightly.
-🌽wasn’t crying in the beginning, but when she heard⚒️said that she was thankful that she didn’t graduate, 🌽can’t hold but burst out crying.
-After the fes, 🌸☄️went home together.
-🌽🌸were invited to stay at a hotel during the festival. The managers knew their room numbers in case anyone overslept the managers knew where to find the talents.
-🌸couldn’t fall asleep right away so she Lined🌽if she wanted to come over to her room. 🌽didn’t reply maybe because she was already sleeping. （or maybe she was too afraid to reply?…)
-The next morning, 🌸found out she forgot to charge her phone but she did wake up before it was too late, she also saw🌽lined her many times to make sure she got up.
-Lately🌸☄️🌽were together almost everyday.
-The reason🌸changed her streaming time it’s because they were having a meeting where all Gen0 talents joined.
-☄️‘s Newton MV is in making.
-☄️would like to have her solo EXPO.
-The talents were all looking for female fans at the standby room when watching the venue live cam. Whenever their female fans showed up on the monitor they get very excited.
-☄️felt great pressure when she found out she will be the finale of the show.
-There were deck of cards kept in the standby room. The talents were playing the cards and🌸were cheating and got caught.
-🌸have great respect for🌽’s love towards Hololive.
-🌸cried again when she found out☄️modified the lyrics of Last Frontier.
-Before the EXPO was opened to the public, Holomems were given a tour, with the guidance from the staff. The Holomems were divided into smaller groups. Where🌸☄️🔥🐑were in a group. 🔥🐑behaved but🌸☄️were running around like kids, and took lots of photos with their plushies.
-At the food tasting stage, 🌸ordered the business combo, but☄️ordered SMOK combo, 🌸asked☄️angrily, why didn’t you order the business combo,☄️replied, you will let me eat yours, so we will be sharing our meals.
-When the managements were deciding what kind of food they should be serving in the business combo, the original plan was something sweet like desserts, but🌸☄️was afraid maybe that was too obvious so they changed it to burgers.
-There was no surprise that🍃ordered the business combo. 🌸☄️autographed the mcmt card that came with it. 🍃is not just a hoshiyomi but also a solid hoshiyomikopi now.
-🌸☄️were worried about the half heart card being too obvious so they asked the managements if that was okay, and eventually that got kept on the wall.
-The staff meal during the performance was a buffet. ☄️grabbed loads of meat and as expected, absolutely zero vegetables.
-There will be a ShiraKen collab with announcements on March 24th.
-🌸would like to have her own solo live, so she is working hard on releasing songs back to back lately.
-🌸said sorry she couldn’t finish all the super chats reading today but she will go back to her normal stream schedule starting tomorrow. Also please enjoy the taiyakis before the collaboration ends.
